name: A Supernatural Device
summary: Deliana needs a way to speak with Anthion Harmon's ghost. You carry the collected blood to an engineer in Gadgetzan as payment for a device that speaks with the dead.

sections.title: Payment for an Engineer
sections.body: Deliana seeks a way to reach Anthion Harmon, or rather his ghost. She has Mux Manascrambler in mind, an engineer who claims to have a machine for speaking with the dead. The blood you collected was meant for him all along. Carry it to Mux in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris, and give it to him for his services.

sections.title: A Welcome Delivery
sections.body: Mux is glad to receive the blood, for his supply was running low. Then he asks whether Deliana sent you.

faq.q: Why does Deliana send you to Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Deliana wants to speak with Anthion Harmon's ghost. An engineer in Gadgetzan claims he can build a machine to speak with the dead, so you bring him payment.

faq.q: What is inside the container being delivered?
faq.answer: The sealed container holds the blood you collected to pay for the engineer's services.

faq.q: Who receives the delivery in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler receives it. He is an engineer in Gadgetzan with a peculiar fascination for the supernatural.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, Deliana sends you to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
